patches.rationale: The bug is that `dict(reservations)` collapses repeated SKU entries, keeping only the last quantity. Fix by iterating over all reservations and accumulating subtractions per SKU, clamping at zero, ignoring unknown SKUs, and not mutating inputs. Add a new regression test file covering all acceptance contracts.
contract_tests: tests/test_inventory_regression.py::test_repeated_sku_reservations_are_all_subtracted asserts the result type is dict and value type is int
tests/test_inventory_regression.py::test_unknown_sku_reservations_ignored asserts available_units({'A': 10}, [('B', 4)]) == {'A': 10} and 'B' not in result
